title: Cow wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Cow body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='27' ry='20' fill='#f4f0e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='27' ry='20' fill='none' stroke='#d8d0c0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Black patches in lit slate purple -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='62' rx='8' ry='6' fill='#6a5a9a'/>
  <ellipse cx='63' cy='72' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#6a5a9a'/>
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='56' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#6a5a9a'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='33' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f4f0e8' stroke='#d8d0c0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='60' y='82' width='7' height='12' rx='3' fill='#f4f0e8' stroke='#d8d0c0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='33' y='90' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <rect x='60' y='90' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='20' ry='17' fill='#f4f0e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='36' rx='20' ry='17' fill='none' stroke='#d8d0c0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Ear patch -->
  <ellipse cx='33' cy='30' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#6a5a9a'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='26' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0b8b0' stroke='#e09a92' stroke-width='2'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='26' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f0b8b0' stroke='#e09a92' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- Horns -->
  <path d='M40 20 Q38 12 44 12' fill='none' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M60 20 Q62 12 56 12' fill='none' stroke='#e8d8a0' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Sunglasses -->
  <rect x='32' y='30' width='16' height='11' rx='4' fill='#3a2a6a' stroke='#8a7ac0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='52' y='30' width='16' height='11' rx='4' fill='#3a2a6a' stroke='#8a7ac0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='47' y='34' width='6' height='3' fill='#3a2a6a'/>
  <!-- Glint on lenses -->
  <rect x='35' y='33' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b8a8e8'/>
  <rect x='55' y='33' width='4' height='2' rx='1' fill='#b8a8e8'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='49' rx='11' ry='7' fill='#f0b8b0'/>
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='48' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c07870'/>
  <ellipse cx='54' cy='48' rx='2' ry='2.5' fill='#c07870'/>
  <path d='M47 53 Q50 56 53 53' fill='none' stroke='#c07870' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
